quality.review_scope: Scoped independent main-only audit: main PDF pages 1–9, all source figures and reported Methods. Matching SI and cited external methods remain unavailable; exact preparation-to-specimen joins remain qualified.
missing_fields: Matching SI and cited external precursor methods unavailable. Table isolated yields are molecular preparation yields, not CdS conversion yields.
Reported substituents are retained symbolically; Table 1 precursor 3 remains in unresolved conflict with the Methods identity.
conflicts: Table 1 row 3 has X1=O-4-Me-Ph, while main p.7 individual Methods title/reagent/formula define O-phenyl compound 3. No corrected identity is substituted.
